TRUESPEECH
Tier 2, wizard (N)
Duration: Instant
Range: Close
A natural creature you 
touch understands and can 
communicate with you in the 
true language of all animals.
You can ask the creature one yes 
or no question. The GM truthfully 
answers "yes" or "no."
If you cast this spell more than 
once on the same creature in 24 
hours, treat a failed spellcasting 
check for it as a critical failure 
instead. 
WHISPERWIND
Tier 1, wizard (N)
Duration: Instant
Range: Far
You send a brief, whispered 
message that reaches any 
creature in range.
